description: TWIST1 pLoF carrier frequency in gnomAD v4 with Clopper-Pearson intervals, compared to reported SCS prevalence
code:
import requests, json, pandas as pd, numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import beta
H={"User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0 openscientist","Content-Type":"application/json","Accept":"application/json"}
q="""query{ gene(gene_symbol:"TWIST1", reference_genome:GRCh38){
 variants(dataset: gnomad_r4){ variant_id consequence hgvsp lof flags exome{ac an} genome{ac an} } }}"""
raw=requests.post("https://gnomad.broadinstitute.org/api",data=json.dumps({"query":q}),headers=H,timeout=180).json()["data"]["gene"]["variants"]
rows=[]
for d in raw:
    e=d.get("exome") or {}; g=d.get("genome") or {}
    rows.append(dict(cons=d["consequence"],hgvsp=d.get("hgvsp"),lof=d.get("lof"),
                     lcr=("lcr" in (d.get("flags") or [])),
                     ac=(e.get("ac") or 0)+(g.get("ac") or 0),an=(e.get("an") or 0)+(g.get("an") or 0)))
v=pd.DataFrame(rows); AN=int(v.an.max()); N=AN//2
hc=v[v.lof=="HC"]
def ci(ac,n):  # Clopper-Pearson
    lo = beta.ppf(0.025, ac, n-ac+1) if ac>0 else 0.0
    hi = beta.ppf(0.975, ac+1, n-ac)
    return lo,hi
print("gnomAD v4 TWIST1: max AN = %d alleles (~%s individuals)"%(AN,f"{N:,}"))
out=[]
for lab,s in [("all HC pLoF",hc),("HC pLoF excl. Gly-rich low-complexity repeat",hc[~hc.lcr])]:
    ac=int(s.ac.sum()); lo,hi=ci(ac,AN)
    out.append(dict(set=lab,n_var=len(s),AC=ac,cumAF=ac/AN,carrier_1_in=AN/(2*ac),
                    ci_lo_1_in=1/(2*hi), ci_hi_1_in=1/(2*lo)))
res=pd.DataFrame(out); print(res.to_string(index=False))
print("\nConsequence mix of HC pLoF alleles:"); print(hc.groupby(["cons","lcr"]).ac.sum().to_string())

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(8.5,3.8))
labels=["gnomAD HC pLoF\ncarriers (all)","gnomAD HC pLoF carriers\n(excl. Gly repeat)","Reported Saethre-Chotzen\nbirth prevalence"]
vals=[res.carrier_1_in[0],res.carrier_1_in[1],37500]
low=[vals[0]-res.ci_lo_1_in[0],vals[1]-res.ci_lo_1_in[1],12500]
up=[res.ci_hi_1_in[0]-vals[0],res.ci_hi_1_in[1]-vals[1],12500]
ax.bar(labels,vals,color=["#c0392b","#e07b54","#2c7fb8"])
ax.errorbar(range(3),vals,yerr=[low,up],fmt="none",ecolor="k",capsize=5)
ax.set_ylabel("1 in N individuals")
ax.set_title("TWIST1 loss-of-function carrier frequency in gnomAD v4 sits in the same range\nas the reported birth prevalence of Saethre-Chotzen syndrome",fontsize=10)
for i,val in enumerate(vals): ax.text(i,val*1.05,f"1 in {val:,.0f}",ha="center",fontsize=9)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
